Set env vars: `export BRAINTRUST_API_KEY='your-api-key'`; `export BRAINTRUST_PROJECT='your-project-name'`; `export BRAINTRUST_DEBUG=true`. Config: `.opencode/braintrust.json` or `~/.config/opencode/braintrust.json`; env overrides config. Enable tracing with `TRACE_TO_BRAINTRUST=true`. Truthy booleans: `true`, `TRUE`, `1`. Run:
`./install.sh && TRACE_TO_BRAINTRUST=true BRAINTRUST_DEBUG=true opencode run -m anthropic/claude-3-haiku-20240307 "say hello and nothing else"`
Logs: `~/.local/share/opencode/log/`.
